commands.name: open_app
commands.description: Open an application on the Mac.

args.app: Name of the app to open

commands.name: open_website
commands.description: Open a well-known website in the browser.

commands.name: search_web
commands.description: Search Google in the browser for some words.

args.query: What to search for, in a few words

commands.name: compose_email
commands.description: Write a new email in Mail (it is NOT sent; sending is a separate command).

args.subject: A short subject line
args.body: The message, as one or two short sentences

commands.name: send_email
commands.description: Send the email that was just written.

commands.name: read_latest_email
commands.description: Read the newest email out loud.

commands.name: type_text
commands.description: Type some words into the app the person is using.

commands.name: close_app
commands.description: Close (quit) the app the person is using.

commands.name: scroll_up
commands.description: Scroll the page up. The person says: up.

commands.name: scroll_down
commands.description: Scroll the page down. The person says: down.

commands.name: go_back
commands.description: Go back to the previous page. The person says: back.

commands.name: go_forward
commands.description: Go forward to the next page. The person says: forward.

commands.name: press_left
commands.description: Press the left arrow key (previous item). The person says: left.

commands.name: press_right
commands.description: Press the right arrow key (next item). The person says: right.

commands.name: press_return
commands.description: Press Return to select the current item. The person says: select.
